title: A subscription made while no room holds its id is the room's that holds the id when it reads its first event: it reads that room's typing, and nothing of another room the store holds under the id once the first is gone
notes: early subscribes before later exists, and reads first's typing in the room the store holds next, its gate telling that the read happened before the room is deleted: its mark is that room's. The store deletes the room and holds another under the id, both written to the store straight, a day apart, so that no kit's room creation ends the subscriptions: early reads nothing of the new room's typing, by its mark alone, while late, subscribed to the new room, reads second's. Not observed: an event of a room gone before the subscription read it, since no step holds a subscription's read.
